anchor: bottom centre of each cell (lying: the floor line; falling: the renderer puts the pickup point 6 px above the cell's bottom)

lying.note: it rests on its grip butt and the underside (10 degrees down), the tag flat before it

falling.note: it comes down under a small parachute in the weapon's own colours, four cords to its top line; the canopy sways a pixel

grip_note: per cell: where the weapon's grip point is in the cell (px, y down), for a hand-over or a catch
star: lying frames: the blue interlaced star on an ivory roundel floats over it, whole, bobbing a pixel (as the shotgun's pickup); falling frames: the weapon's own mark hangs under it with the star
